assumptions: The measured coupled support remains 25-70 C and RH 0-0.55.
All Young Toth and GAB coefficients are evaluated unchanged through the explicit 25-120 C numerical envelope.
IAPWS saturation replaces only the saturation correlation inside this separate provider.
The actual evolving stored-water inventory drives the Young WADST CO2 target.
Hot binary coupling, adsorption/desorption rates and energy transfer are unvalidated transfers.
Wilkins 110 C and Low 2023 measurements are diagnostic constraints, not fitted corrections or same-specimen validation.

co2.source_locator: Young et al. 2021 DOI 10.1039/D1EE01272J Tables 2 and 4; process heat from SI Table S9

evidence.basis: The original Young 2021 Toth and GAB coefficients, LDF rates and process heats are evaluated unchanged from local p_H2O with IAPWS saturation in an explicit 25-120 C numerical envelope. Measured coupled support ends at 70 C.
evidence.not_for: validated 116 C equilibrium or coupling, hot adsorption/desorption rate prediction, hot-vacuum energy validation, measured humid-cycle accuracy, hardware qualification, cyclic steady state, lifetime or annual production.

kinetics.evidence_status: Unchanged Young 2021 SI Table S9 process constants. Equal adsorption/desorption, humid-CO2 transfer and hot-vacuum transfer are assumptions, not measured validation.

name: Lewatit VP OC 1065, Young 2021 hot numerical extrapolation

adsorbed_energy.basis: Constant CP_GAS and 70/46 kJ/mol process heats preserve the original convention.

equilibrium.class: unchanged source-reproduced Young fit outside its measured coupled domain

loaded_builtin.name: Lewatit VP OC 1065, Young 2021 hot numerical extrapolation

measured_constraint.status: not spliced into the Young coefficient set

saturation_pressure.reason: The original Buck implementation has no declared hot-validity interval; IAPWS is used only by the separate hot provider.

shaped_material.basis: The app case supplies a dry shaped resin mass; the source measured resin sample is not a shaped device.
shaped_material.binder_support: Commercial resin beads are represented as the dry resin solid; no binder or support is added.
shaped_material.particle_geometry: The case particle diameter remains a transfer assumption.

uncertainty.statement: The calculation is authorized as a transparent conditional scenario. No percentage accuracy statement or measured 116 C validation follows.

validity.cycle: Numerical scenario only; hot rates, caloric closure, drainage and thermal lag are unvalidated.
validity.equilibrium: Measured coupled support ends at 70 C; 116 C output is conditional numerical extrapolation.
validity.initial_state_interpretation: Equilibrated initialization is a numerical scenario state, not cyclic steady state.
validity.water: Local IAPWS RH is used within the original 0-0.55 envelope; no hot cross-temperature fit is adopted.

water.basis: Unchanged Young GAB coefficients evaluated with local p_H2O / IAPWS saturation. The measured water evidence is used as a diagnostic constraint only and is not spliced into the Young specimen.
water.source_locator: Young et al. 2021 DOI 10.1039/D1EE01272J equations 5-8 and 25-26; process heat from SI Table S9
